source_locator: Page 1, MAYOR contest, 121 of 121 precincts reporting
verification_note: The official results document is headed Official Results and shows 121 of 121 precincts. It was last updated March 24, 2011 and does not print the election date. The runoff date of March 22, 2011 follows from the first round on March 1, 2011 (the first-round document was last updated March 3, 2011) and the three-week runoff interval seen in 2015. Buckhorn 26,708 (62.86 percent), Ferlita 15,778 (37.14 percent), total 42,486. First-round totals were Ferlita 10,808, Buckhorn 9,824, Greco 9,441, Turanchik 8,110, Scott 3,601, with no majority.

source_locator: Summary Results, Mayor contest, 93 of 93 precincts
verification_note: The official Hillsborough election night reporting page for the March 3, 2015 Tampa municipal election shows Bob Buckhorn with 24,607 votes (95.91 percent). The only other line is generic Write-In with 1,049 votes (4.09 percent), with no named qualified candidate, so only the winner is recorded as an uncontested race.

source_locator: Summary Results, Mayor contest, 103 of 103 precincts
verification_note: The official results page for the April 23, 2019 Tampa runoff shows Jane Castor 38,859 (73.10 percent) and David Straz 14,300 (26.90 percent), total 53,159. The first round on March 5, 2019 (https://enr.electionsfl.org/HIL/2083/Summary/) had Castor at 23,324 (47.98 percent), below a majority, so the runoff decided the office.

source_locator: Certificate of County Canvassing Board dated March 10, 2023, line For Mayor
verification_note: The County Canvassing Board certificate lists Jane Castor 22,988 and Belinda Noah (write-in) 2,138, total 25,126. The Race Results with Qualified Write-Ins document gives the same totals (Castor 91.49 percent, Noah 8.51 percent). The election night reporting page shows 5,698 generic write-in votes, which include votes for non-qualified names. Only qualified write-in votes count in certified results.
